lead_types.student_association: Student unions and student associations at the school that run paid, ticketed student events: the student union's events or programming team, faculty and engineering societies, residence councils, graduate student associations and large cultural or faculty associations. Look for their upcoming paid events (formals, galas, semi-formals, concerts, pub nights, ski or bus trips, cultural shows, conferences) and their events, programming or VP Events contact. These organizers run many events a year, so the ask is to list their upcoming paid events on Wat2Do. This is the top priority lead type.
lead_types.hackathon: Student-run hackathons, game jams, case competitions and similar build or compete weekends at the school or open to its students, with an upcoming date. The organizer team (directors, sponsorship or outreach leads) is the contact.
lead_types.ticketed_event: Upcoming paid or ticketed events run by individual student clubs at the school (not the student union or a faculty society, which are covered separately): club galas, cultural shows, concerts, competitions with tickets and paid socials. The club or its events or marketing lead is the contact.

offer: Wat2Do lists every campus event at a school in one feed, free for students and organizers. Submitting an event takes about two minutes on the school's submit page, and it then shows up for students browsing what to do that week, on the school's Wat2Do page and in the school's Wat2Do Instagram event carousels.
